query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_students,
  SUM(feePerQuarter) as total_quarterly_fee,
  venue,
  COUNT(*) as student_count,
  SUM(feePerQuarter) as venue_total
FROM students
GROUP BY venue
ORDER BY venue;
